learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire broad and sound knowledge of the scientific theories, principles, and methods of power and turbomachinery in the basic core subjects of the specialization in order to design, use, and evaluate them.

Building on this, students deepen selected application fields in the supplementary subjects, so that they are subsequently able to independently analyze and evaluate problems from this application field and develop solutions based on this.
After completing the specialization, students can specifically name the function and application of power and turbomachinery.
Describe and apply the state of the art and resulting application fields of power and turbomachinery by example.
Name, use and evaluate fundamental theories, methods and properties for the various application fields of power and turbomachinery.

syllabus_topics: Structure and function of various energy converting machines in the core area
Supplementary basics, sub-points, and detailed questions of the aforementioned machines in the supplementary area
Application-oriented project planning and development of systems
assessment_rules: See individual partial performances of SP24.
